_comment: History Teaching Methods -- Secondary Teachers' Diploma syllabus, Years 1-2.
First typeset 2026-10-12. Layout and numbering repairs only: NONE of these rewrites a
competence, an activity or an expected standard.
THE FILE NAME ('HISTORY METHODS VALIDATED TED') names neither the level nor the year.
The cover is set from the manuscript's own cover page instead: 'HISTORY SYLLABUS /
TEACHING METHODS / SECONDARY TEACHERS' DIPLOMA', and 'Curriculum Development Centre,
NUMBERING (renumberMatrix). Not one number in the matrix is typed except three
competences (1.2.3.1, 1.2.4.1, 2.8.1.1) and topic '2.1 PREPARATION TO TEACH': the rest
are Word list numbers, and the Year 1 topics carry none at all. The matrix is numbered
from its structure: topic Y.k, sub-topic Y.k.j, competence Y.k.j.m -- Year 1 topics
1.1-1.9, Year 2 topics 2.1-2.8, which is how the manuscript's own contents list numbers
them. Titles and wording are untouched.
STILL OUTSTANDING -- needs the author, not the typesetter:
* Confirm the numbering (above).
* Competences tables: the S/N column skipped numbers (Year 1: 1-8, 10, 12; Year 2:
1, 3-10). The engine counts them afresh, 1-10 and 1-9.
* Competences tables: 'Digital' is the competence name in both years, where the
family's tables have 'Digital Literacy'. Set as written.
* Year 2 Competences: under Communication, 'Identify the different levels of each
domain' and 'Apply levels of Bloom's Taxonomy in education' are Year 1 matrix
competences (topic 1.7); under Critical Thinking, 'Interpret Bloom's Taxonomy' and
'Analyse roles of AI in teaching history' likewise. Set as written.
* ISBN: none in the manuscript; the imprint shows a blank ISBN line.
* 1.4.1.1: the method 'Question and answer' is typed in the same paragraph as the
activity above it ('...during the scenario.'), so it sets at the end of that bullet
rather than as a method line of its own. No override can split one paragraph in a
matrix cell without losing the cell's bold runs; correct it in the manuscript.

ROUND 1 (Google Drive, Mabvuto Nkhata, 22 and 26 Oct 2026): 9 comments. ZEEP 'Education' -> delete: marked resolved by the reviewer himself, not changed. 1.4.1.1 expected standard reworded as written. Topic 1.7 (Bloom’s Taxonomy): 1.7.2.1 competence and standard 'in the Bloom’s Taxonomy' after 'domain' (the comments say 'in the Bloom’s'; 'Taxonomy' completes the name); 1.7.3.1 competence 'different' after 'Apply', its standard opens 'Different'. The e-mails carry no highlighted words for these; placed from the topic they speak of. One, 'Delete the highlighted', names nothing and is NOT placed. Director signatory -> Samutete M. Petronella (Ms); 2025 -> 2026 (year key, copyright and First Published lines).

insertText._why: The copyright line. The manuscript types it as a Heading 1 ('Curriculum Development Centre, 2025', no (c) sign), the importer drops it as a heading in the imprint, and the imprint page went without it. ROUND 1 (26 Oct): year 2026.
The Vision statement, word for word. The manuscript styles it 'TOC Heading 1', and the importer drops every TOC-styled paragraph as hand-typed contents, so the VISION page came out empty.

The year headings above the two matrices, in the family's wording, so that each sets as the YEAR divider page.
